question: How do short breaks affect a day of focused work?
rightAnswer: They give you time to recover, so you feel less tired.

misconceptions.label: Short breaks do not help you recover
Taking a break drains your mental energy
Recovery should wait until you are exhausted

authorOptions.text: They leave your fatigue unchanged, so skipping them has no recovery cost.
They use up your mental energy, so you return feeling more tired.
They work best after exhaustion, so you should save them for later.
